visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting a man in a suit leaning over a large, complex mechanical apparatus. The man is positioned horizontally, reaching down with one hand to grasp a heavy metal chain that hangs in a loop beneath the machinery. The setting appears to be an industrial or shipboard environment with a riveted metal wall in the background. The style is characteristic of 19th-century book illustrations.
